description: Create combat idle pose B as a SMALL anatomical variation of each provided pose A. Keep the exact same character, pixel style, canvas, scale, camera and EACH input's facing direction: first SOUTH-EAST front 3/4, second NORTH-WEST back 3/4. LOCK BOTH FEET AND ANKLES in exactly their input pixel positions; keep the floor and horizontal body root fixed. Bend the knees a little more and lower the pelvis about TWO native pixels. Let torso and head follow this small lowering, with chest leaning forward by only ONE pixel, like a compressed spring taking a quiet breath. Preserve the head, calm eyes, muzzle and both asymmetric ear shapes EXACTLY in design and size, just following the body down; never turn the head. Preserve the existing low dagger grip, blade length, raised empty-hand guard and all costume/gear. Both arms follow the torso by this tiny amount. Tiny scarf-tip settling only. Same compact poised silhouette, subtly more loaded legs; no deep crouch, no step, no whole-sprite translation or scaling, no attack, no additional weapon, no VFX. Full-body single native 64x64 pixel sprite on transparent background. Preserve all pixels not needed for this slight knee/hip compression.
